key_products: Go2/B2 quadrupeds; G1/H1/R1 humanoids
description: World's largest quadruped and humanoid robot maker by volume; listed on the STAR Market (688836.SH) in Aug 2026 after a record-fast 104-day IPO review, with 2025 revenue of RMB 1.7B and 5500+ humanoids shipped in 2025.
why_it_matters: Category-defining volume leader whose IPO sets the valuation benchmark for the entire Chinese embodied-AI sector.

key_products: Yuanzheng A2, Lingxi X2 humanoids; AgiBot World dataset
description: Co-founded by ex-Huawei 'genius youth' Peng Zhihui, it became the world's top humanoid shipper (~5200 units in 2025) and started its Hong Kong IPO process in Jul 2026 targeting a HK$40-50B valuation after taking control of A-share listed Swancor.
why_it_matters: Fastest-scaling humanoid player with Huawei-pedigree management, aiming to be the sector's second blockbuster IPO.

key_products: Walker S industrial humanoids; education & logistics robots
description: China's first listed humanoid company (HKEX 9880, Dec 2023) with ~RMB 5.61B raised pre-IPO; it booked RMB 1.4B of humanoid orders in 2025, the largest disclosed order book in the industry.
why_it_matters: The most commercially proven listed pure-play on industrial humanoids in China.

key_products: GR-1/GR-2/GR-3 humanoids; rehab exoskeletons
description: Rehab-robotics veteran (2000+ clients in 40+ countries) that pivoted to humanoids; raised ~RMB 1.4B+ in total including an 2025 E round at a RMB 8B valuation, and is preparing a STAR Market IPO.
why_it_matters: Rare robot maker with a profitable-adjacent medical revenue base funding its humanoid ambitions.

key_products: PM01, SE01, T800 humanoids; JS01 quadruped
description: Founded Oct 2023 by serial entrepreneur Zhao Tongyang (ex-XPeng Robotics); known for high-dynamic humanoids (front-flip PM01, 173cm T800) and the URKL robot fighting league, with cumulative funding near RMB 1B and a confidential HKEX filing reported.
why_it_matters: High-visibility humanoid challenger turning viral motion-control tech into industrial orders.

key_products: TRON 1 biped; W1 wheel-legged; humanoid platforms
description: Legged-locomotion specialist founded by CMU-trained scientists; raised a ~$200M Series B (early 2026) and a ~$200M Pre-IPO round in Jul 2026 at a RMB 15B post-money valuation.
why_it_matters: Deep locomotion IP plus fresh Pre-IPO capital make it a near-term listing candidate.

key_products: STAR1/L7 humanoids; XHAND dexterous hand; ERA-42 VLA model
description: Tsinghua-incubated (Aug 2023, founder Chen Jianyu) full-stack humanoid firm; first Chinese embodied player to prove PMF in logistics with China Post and SF Express, raising RMB 10B+ in 2026 including a RMB 2.5B Pre-IPO round.
why_it_matters: Its logistics deployments and world-model research give it both revenue and technical differentiation.

key_products: Kuavo full-size humanoids; Aelos education robots
description: Harbin Institute of Technology spin-off (2016) whose Kuavo humanoid ranked #4 globally by 2025 shipments (577 units); its ChiNext IPO application was accepted in May 2026 after a RMB 1.5B Pre-IPO round.
why_it_matters: Education-to-industrial humanoid pioneer with an open IPO path on ChiNext's fourth-tier standard.

key_products: Jueying X20/X30 quadrupeds; Lynx wheel-legged; DR01 humanoid
description: Zhejiang University spin-off and 'Hangzhou Six Little Dragons' member; #1 globally in industrial quadruped application revenue, profitable in 2025 (RMB 337M revenue), and its STAR Market IPO (raising RMB 2.5B) was accepted in May 2026.
why_it_matters: The B2B counterweight to Unitree with real industrial inspection revenue and profits.

key_products: CR/Nova/MG400 cobot arms; Dobot Atom humanoid
description: World's #1 collaborative robot maker by shipments (13.2% share, 100k+ units), listed on HKEX (2432.HK) in Dec 2024 as the 'first cobot stock'; passed ChiNext review in 2026 as the first Greater Bay Area H-to-A returnee.
why_it_matters: Scaled, profitable-adjacent cobot franchise now extending into humanoids at disruptive price points.

key_products: Goods-to-person AMRs; Geek+ Brain embodied model
description: World's largest warehouse AMR vendor; listed on HKEX (2590.HK) in Jul 2025 in the biggest H-share robotics IPO, and booked RMB 4.14B of orders in 2025 (+31.7% YoY).
why_it_matters: The most globally scaled Chinese warehouse-robotics business with public-market liquidity.

key_products: BellaBot/KettyBot delivery robots; PUDU CC1 cleaning; D9 humanoid
description: Global commercial service robot leader shipping tens of thousands of units to 60+ countries; raised a ~RMB 1B Series E in Apr 2026 at a valuation above RMB 10B.
why_it_matters: Scale manufacturer of service robots with global distribution and a humanoid option.

key_products: DINERBOT delivery robots; KLEENBOT cleaning; XMAN humanoid
description: Pioneer of restaurant delivery robots with operations in 600+ cities worldwide; raised a $200M SoftBank Vision Fund-led Series D in 2021, the largest single round in Chinese commercial service robotics at the time.
why_it_matters: Longest-tenured service-robot brand with unmatched global installed base.

key_products: MagicBot humanoid; MagicDog quadruped; dexterous hands
description: Dreame-ecosystem humanoid startup (founded Jan 2024) whose MagicBot is already training on factory lines; it served as the intelligent-robot partner of CCTV's 2026 Spring Festival Gala.
why_it_matters: Consumer-electronics manufacturing DNA from Dreame could make it a cost disruptor in humanoids.

key_products: Galbot G1 wheeled humanoid; GraspVLA/TrackVLA models
description: Founded May 2023 by PKU professor Wang He (Stanford PhD); a simulation-data-driven embodied-AI leader deploying autonomous picking robots across dozens of retail warehouses, with ~RMB 7B raised including a RMB 2.5B round backed by the National AI Industry Fund in Mar 2026.
why_it_matters: The 'embodied brain national team' bet, backed by China's state AI fund and top consumer internet giants.

key_products: WALL-A/WALL-B embodied models; Quantum 1/2 robots
description: Founded Dec 2023 by Tsinghua/USC-trained Wang Qian, an early attention-mechanism researcher; pursues an end-to-end unified embodied model (WALL-B) and is the only Chinese embodied startup backed separately by Meituan, Alibaba, ByteDance and Xiaomi, with RMB 5B+ raised.
why_it_matters: Its unified world-model architecture is China's most credible technical alternative to the VLA mainstream.

key_products: R1 humanoid series; A1 robot arms; G0/G0.5 embodied models
description: Tsinghua/Waymo-pedigree team (founded Sep 2023, CEO Gao Jiyang) building a 'one brain, many bodies' stack; raised RMB 2B B+ in Apr 2026 at a valuation above RMB 20B, roughly 2x in two months.
why_it_matters: Fastest valuation climber among embodied 'brain' startups with a full-stack hardware flywheel.

key_products: Alpha Bot series; GOVLA embodied model
description: Founded Apr 2023 by Guo Yandong (ex-chief scientist of XPeng and OPPO); completed 12 rounds in a year and a ~RMB 5B round in Jun 2026 at a 20B+ valuation, with a 1000-unit, ~RMB 500M order from display maker HKC described by Morgan Stanley as the largest single productivity-robot order globally.
why_it_matters: Big-tech scientist founder plus a landmark industrial order make it a commercialization frontrunner.

key_products: Moz1 force-controlled humanoid; Spirit v1.5 VLA model
description: Founded Jan 2024 by Han Fengtao (Rokae co-founder) and Tsinghua professor Gao Yang; its Spirit v1.5 topped the RoboChallenge Table30 benchmark ahead of Physical Intelligence's Pi0.5, and it raised ~RMB 4.5B within three months in 2026 including rounds led by Shunwei and Yunfeng.
why_it_matters: Benchmark-beating VLA model plus the largest real-world data-collection network in China.

key_products: TARS humanoid for wire-harness assembly
description: Founded Feb 2025 by Baidu's former intelligent-driving president Li Zhenyu and ex-Huawei autonomous-driving CTO Chen Yilun; set the sector's angel-round record ($120M) and raised a ~$455M Pre-A in Apr 2026 at a 20B+ valuation, targeting cable-harness assembly in auto/3C factories with 15 units already delivered.
why_it_matters: Autonomous-driving all-star team attacking one of manufacturing's hardest unsolved tasks.

key_products: Mech-Eye 3D cameras; Mech-Vision/Mech-Viz software; dexterous hands
description: Tsinghua-returnee founded (2016) leader in 3D-vision 'eyes and brains' for industrial robots with 20B+ RMB cumulative funding from Meituan, Sequoia China and Intel Capital; passed IPO filing registration and was reportedly pre-marketing a ~$300M HK IPO in Aug 2026.
why_it_matters: Picks-and-shovels infrastructure supplier to the whole embodied-AI boom, nearing the public market.

key_products: DeepSeek-V3/R1/V4 open-source models
description: High-Flyer-backed lab (founded Jul 2023 by Liang Wenfeng) whose low-cost open-source R1 reset global AI economics in Jan 2025; after years of refusing outside money it reportedly closed a ~RMB 51B Series A in Jun 2026 with Tencent, JD, CATL and NetEase at a ~RMB 400B valuation.
why_it_matters: China's most influential open-source model lab, now capitalized to compete at the frontier.

key_products: Kimi assistant; Kimi K2/K3 open-source models
description: Founded Apr 2023 by Yang Zhilin (CMU PhD, Transformer-XL co-author); its 2.8T-parameter open-source Kimi K3 (Jul 2026) ranked #3 globally on Artificial Analysis, ARR hit $300M by Jun 2026, and it confidentially filed for a HK IPO in Sep 2026 while raising a Pre-IPO round at a $50B pre-money valuation.
why_it_matters: China's highest-valued foundation-model startup with genuine global C-end mindshare.

key_products: GLM model series; ChatGLM; AutoGLM agent
description: Tsinghua-born GLM developer that listed on HKEX on Jan 8 2026 as the 'world's first foundation-model stock', later launching a RMB 15B STAR Market A-share plan and a HK$31.4B placement; its GLM series is among the few trained fully on domestic (Ascend) compute.
why_it_matters: The policy-favored, A+H listed champion of sovereign Chinese foundation models.

key_products: MiniMax-M series LLMs; Hailuo AI video; Talkie/Xingye companions
description: Multimodal model company (LLM, video, audio) that listed on HKEX (00100) on Jan 9 2026, doubling on debut to a HK$100B+ market cap, and raised a further ~HK$16B via placement plus convertible bonds in Jul 2026.
why_it_matters: Proves consumer-AI monetization at scale and is the best-performing Chinese model IPO to date.

key_products: Step series LLMs/multimodal models; on-device phone AI
description: Founded 2023 by former Microsoft global VP Jiang Daxin; supplies AI to 60% of leading Chinese phone brands (42M+ devices shipped), raised a record RMB 5B+ round in Jan 2026 and a $2.5B Pre-IPO round, targeting a HKEX filing in 2026.
why_it_matters: Owns the on-device distribution channel that other model startups lack.

key_products: MiniCPM edge model series
description: Tsinghua THUNLP spin-off (2022) pioneering efficient on-device foundation models under its 'density law'; MiniCPM downloads exceeded 38M, it raised RMB 5B+ in H1 2026 at a 20B+ valuation, and filed for A-share IPO tutoring in Aug 2026.
why_it_matters: The leading bet that small, dense models win the edge-AI and embodied-AI endpoint.

key_products: SenseNova model suite; SenseCore AI cloud; industrial AI solutions
description: Hong Kong-listed (0020.HK, Dec 2021) AI pioneer spanning computer vision, the SenseNova foundation-model family and one of Asia's largest AI computing infrastructures, serving enterprise and government clients across Asia and the Middle East.
why_it_matters: The incumbent bridge between China's first AI wave and the foundation-model era.

key_products: Manus general AI agent; Cue
description: Creator of the Manus general AI agent (Mar 2025) — the fastest startup ever to reach $100M ARR; survived a blocked $2B Meta acquisition (China's NDRC vetoed it in Apr 2026), resumed independent operation in Sep 2026, and raised $500M+ in Oct 2026 at a ~$4B valuation led by Boyu and IDG with Tencent participating.
why_it_matters: The flagship proof that Chinese-founded agent companies can build global category leaders.

key_products: Laiye RPA platform; Work Execution Platform; Magic Hat
description: Veteran intelligent-automation company that merged with RPA firm UiBot/Aosen in 2019, raised a $70M C++ round in Apr 2022 (total funding $200M+), is a Gartner RPA Magic Quadrant regular, and has retooled its platform around LLM-based digital workers.
why_it_matters: A decade of enterprise automation distribution gives its agent products a ready customer base.
